verdict.rationale: An OpenAPI spec exists (helixdb-probe-2) and the quickstart walks through running a generated query (helixdb-docs-1, helixdb-docs-15), but there's no evidence of an interactive, in-browser API reference (e.g., Swagger/try-it-out UI) with embedded runnable examples. Missing for 10: a documented interactive API explorer/playground, live 'try it now' runnable snippets in the reference pages, and independent confirmation of such tooling.
